#Peering Policy
We maintain an open peering policy on public Route Servers, alongside selective private peering guidelines:
- Route Servers: We peer with all available Route Servers at every Internet Exchange (IX) where we are present.
- Private Peering & PNIs: Private Peering and PNIs are primarily reserved for Cloud- & Content-Provider, and other German ISPs.
- Equinix Data Centers: For connections within Equinix facilities, we are happy to establish redundant private peerings across multiple links upon request.
- General Requests: All other networks are welcome to submit a peering request. Please note, however, that acceptance is evaluated on a case-by-case basis with no guarantee of approval.
